notes: New purchase requirement = batch consumption (including stated process reserve) minus usable stock and already-ordered quantities, floored at zero. Combine shared SKUs, then round only the shortfall to economical whole supplier lots.
The 5-, 10- and 20-machine alternatives use the same opening inventory; do not add the columns. Each includes the current integrated unit under development.

Existing paid parts, printers, tools, fixtures and reusable spools incur no new acquisition expense. Ten defective batch-1 PCBAs and incompatible/abandoned inventory receive no production credit. Already-ordered stock is shown separately from on hand.

The possible-payment reserve covers only identified pending component orders whose stock is credited and whose merchant charge is unresolved. Confirmed charges are excluded: the WR1105 regulators, the Taprite 3741, the FWS drain-line order, and the October PET-GF15 Black, Clear PETG, ASA Aero, Kamoer pump and Beduan valve orders. Release the reserve when payment is confirmed; do not pay the same order twice.
Acquired receipt totals alone do not establish remaining stock. Estimated balances and provisional consumption allowances retain their evidence in the stock ledger.

Terminal/ferrule/heat-shrink assortments without usable counts by required size receive no numerical stock credit. Cut lengths and wire colours require the recorded per-size/colour allowances; aggregate offcuts are not assumed to make another full component.

No purchase is placed. Stock limits are dated observations, not reservations. Labor uses the existing experienced-operator estimate; early builds may take longer. Owner labor is not automatically a future cash payment.

Development spend, extra tooling, rent, payment fees, installation, warranty/support and business taxes are outside the production-and-delivery forecast. Donor interfaces remain qualification items with positive purchase allowances.
The current BOM defines manufacturing demand. Supplier price and availability observations retain their recorded dates.
inventoryNote: Stock evidence, receipts and completed assemblies are shared with Build from stock. Unknown balances receive no credit. Supplier offers retain their recorded price and availability dates.
